newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold Resources to list at $18-23/shr.
newsitem.headline: Randgold Resources to list at $18-23/shr.

text.p: Randgold Resources Ltd (RRL) said on Thursday it plans to list seven million shares on the London Stock Exchange at a price of between $18 and $23 each.
"The $18 to $23 range is based on prelisting visits which syndicates and banks made to senior fund managers over the last two weeks," said Randgold chairman Peter Flack.

RRL, the African gold mining and exploration company, plans to start trading on the London bourse on June 30 through an international offer of approximately seven million new shares and global depositary securities.

Randgold said earlier that RRL had reached the stage where its strategic development required a substantial capital injection with funding required for the development of existing projects, notably the Syama gold mine and Loulo project in Mali.
Funds were also needed for other advanced exploration projects.
Randgold said it could not supply RRL with this financing directly due to the constraints imposed by the South African exchange control system.
"The directors believe the most effective way of facilitating this is to combine the raising of capital with a listing on the London Stock Exchange...," it said.
